remarks: Why rent the ordinary when you can own extraordinary? Welcome to the best unit at Candlelight, pure waterfront from all the windows and decks. This isn't just a 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo-it's your upgrade from "just getting by" to living surrounded by natural beauty and comfort. Perched directly on the Rippowam River in Candlelight Terrace, this waterfront gem delivers the kind of serene views and thoughtful design that most city dwellers only dream about. Start each morning with coffee on your private balcony where the gentle flow of the river creates your personal oasis. Enjoy a spacious bedroom with TWO walk-in closets. Handle laundry on your schedule with your in-unit washer/dryer. Think comfort and waterfront living means high expenses? Think again. Heat, hot water, flood insurance, security cameras, pool access, grill area, parking, and an on-site super are all included in the common charges. Furry friend? Bring them - pets are welcome here. Need storage? Got it. Parking? Plenty. This community is designed to simplify your life, not complicate it. Let's be real: this isn't just a condo. It's low-maintenance living with high-reward perks - just minutes from downtown Stamford, but tucked into a quiet, green corner by the river. Truth is, places like this don't last. Looking for value, location, and lifestyle in one? This is it. Ready to make a move? Reach out now to schedule your private showing before it's gone.
